name: ui-stdlib
description: House UI standard library: semantic contracts and scene adapters.

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ui-stdlib/tokens build && pnpm --filter @ui-stdlib/lint build && eslint . && pnpm --filter @ui-stdlib/lint lint:css && pnpm --filter @ui-stdlib/lint test:css-cli
scripts.validate: pnpm run build && pnpm run schema && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:parity && pnpm run test && pnpm run rag:validate
